label: D2 after a2 led rare to S1, final ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (state shown), only after the agent chose a2, and only near the end of the episode (99% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, nothing before trial 80; tracks the low-value regime, value < 5.2). The strong activations (about 0.5-1.0 of max) are a2 trials that went rare to S1; a2 trials that went common to S2 in the same late period give weak activations (about 0.02-0.2), which make up most of the missed steps (low-quartile coverage is only about 19%). Never fires at D1 or GO, or after a1. All variables are observed at D2 (action, state, trial position), so no future variables. Precision is limited: some late rare a2->S1 steps stay silent, especially at trials 90-91. Magnitude is set mainly by rare vs common and grows as the episode end approaches. Adding the common-a2 late trials (ep_trial >= 97) gives about the same F1 on dev, so I kept the simpler predicate.
